text: Artificial intelligence has become a powerful tool in our daily lives, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: AI systems learn from data, and if that data contains unfair patterns, the AI can make unfair decisions, for example in hiring or lending. Fairness means we must check algorithms carefully to ensure they treat everyone equally. Privacy is another issue, since AI often collects large amounts of personal information, which needs strong protection. Transparency is also vital—people should understand how and why an AI makes its choices. Finally, responsible AI development requires collaboration among engineers, policymakers, and the public to build systems that are safe, honest, and beneficial for society.
